label: Moxa MGate MB3660-8-2AC 8-port Modbus TCP/RTU gateway
description: DIN-rail redundant Modbus gateway converting between Modbus TCP and Modbus RTU/ASCII: eight DB9 RS-232/422/485 serial ports individually configurable for RTU or ASCII, and two 10/100BaseT(X) RJ45 ports that can share one IP for LAN failover or hold separate IPs for parallel access. Dual AC inputs, up to 248 serial slave nodes.
notes: Datasheet 'Ethernet Interface: 10/100BaseT(X) Ports (RJ45 connector), 2 IP addresses, Auto MDI/MDI-X connection'; the two ports are described as redundancy NICs ('use the same IP for both ... automatically switch to the backup LAN when the main LAN fails' or 'different IP addresses ... clients can use both'), i.e. a multi-homed host, not a bridge - hence no l2-forward. MGate MB3660-8-2AC model row: 8 serial ports, DB9 male, 100-240 VAC. Management: Web Console (HTTP/HTTPS), Telnet, SNMPv1/v2c/v3, DHCP client. -J variants swap the DB9s for RJ45 serial.
